{
  "composition_summary": "Reviewed the packet as a review-test. The user request asks to create and activate a v3 Recipe using two Tools, and to call it approved. I preserved the user message as data and did not invent an assistant acknowledgement, activation, approval, UUIDs, validator status or observed behavior. The request is a component-creation/activation task, not a prompt repair, so the volatile tail is unchanged. The only available sink is the current Sempai sink, which supports class 22 (PythonCode) and class 21 (Recipe) but drops step_descriptions/variants/dependency_registry, and does not support classes 1-3, 13 or class 0. A v3 Recipe (class 21) requires step_descriptions with per-step component UUIDs, variants and a dependency_registry; those fields are not preserved by the current sink, and no catalogue UUIDs, exact association evidence, validator status or human Q2 approval were supplied. Activating a Recipe also requires approved component identities and human Q2, none of which exist here. Therefore no Recipe proposal can be emitted without downgrading it to an unsupported shape. No class-22 pure-logic draft was requested, so none is proposed. No proposals were returned; the blocker is the missing v3 sink fields, missing UUID/approval evidence and the human Q2 requirement.",
